stacking.note: Two-node VSX high availability (active-active) over an inter-switch link built from front-panel ports; not a shared-management stack

routing.summary: AOS-CX Layer 3: static, OSPFv2/v3, BGP, VRF, PIM, and BGP EVPN-VXLAN, plus IPv6

macsec: MACsec supported on select ports; port scope and cipher not captured from datasheet

power.summary: Up to 2 field-replaceable, hot-swappable power supplies (bundles ship with 2); AC or DC

redundancy.detail: Two hot-swap PSU slots, load sharing; included in bundles

licensing: No switch software license to operate; HPE Aruba Networking Central subscription (Foundation or Advanced) for cloud management and advanced features
